d:
Man Vs. Wild mein Bear Grylls pahunchte hain duniya ke sabse khatarnak locations par, jahan har kadam par hai ek naya challenge! Kabhi khatarnak jaanwaron ka saamna, toh kabhi mushkil halaat mein survival ki jung. Kya Bear har khatre ko paar karke bach payenge?
Dekhiye Man Vs. Wild ke Season 1 ke Episodes 6, 3, 11, 2, 9, 8 aur 4, sirf Discovery Channel India par!
